exposure: esketamine combined with tramadol for PCIA
butorphanol combined with tramadol for PCIA
outcome: mean numerical rating scale (NRS) scores at rest, sitting, and uterine contraction at 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours postoperatively
cohort: 170 women undergoing cesarean section, randomly assigned to receive either esketamine combined with tramadol or butorphanol combined with tramadol for patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA).
finding: Esketamine combined with tramadol for PCIA improved pain intensity 6 hours postoperatively compared to butorphanol combined with tramadol.
